mapper.insert: INSERT INTO items (name, slot, image_url, is_purchasable, price, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{slot}, #{imageUrl}, #{purchasable}, #{price}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE items SET name = #{name}, slot = #{slot}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, is_purchasable = #{purchasable}, price = #{price} WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.select: SELECT item_id AS itemId, name, slot, image_url AS imageUrl, price, is_purchasable AS purchasable, created_at AS createdAt FROM items WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
SELECT item_id AS itemId, name, slot, image_url AS imageUrl, price, is_purchasable AS purchasable, created_at AS createdAt FROM items WHERE item_id = #{itemId}

SELECT item_id AS itemId, name, slot, image_url AS imageUrl, price, is_purchasable AS purchasable, created_at AS createdAt FROM items ORDER BY item_id DESC LIMIT #{pageable.pageSize} OFFSET #{pageable.offset}
SELECT item_id AS itemId, name, slot, image_url AS imageUrl, price, is_purchasable AS purchasable, created_at AS createdAt FROM items WHERE name = #{name}

SELECT ui.user_id, ui.item_id, ui.quantity, ui.is_equipped, ui.acquired_at, ui.updated_at, i.name as item_name, i.slot, i.image_url, i.price, i.is_purchasable FROM user_items ui JOIN items i ON ui.item_id = i.item_id WHERE ui.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT ui.*, i.name as item_name, i.slot, i.image_url FROM user_items ui JOIN items i ON ui.item_id = i.item_id WHERE ui.user_id = #{userId} AND ui.item_id = #{itemId}
SELECT item_id AS itemId, name, slot, image_url AS imageUrl, price, is_purchasable AS purchasable, created_at AS createdAt FROM items ORDER BY item_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_items (user_id, item_id, is_equipped, acquired_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{itemId}, #{isEquipped}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT ui.user_id, ui.item_id, ui.quantity, ui.is_equipped, i.name as item_name, i.slot, i.image_url FROM user_items ui JOIN items i ON ui.item_id = i.item_id WHERE ui.user_id = #{userId} AND ui.is_equipped = TRUE AND i.slot = #{slot}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_items ui JOIN items i ON ui.item_id = i.item_id SET ui.is_equipped = (CASE WHEN ui.item_id = #{itemId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ui.updated_at = NOW() WHERE ui.user_id = #{userId} AND i.slot = ( SELECT slot FROM (SELECT slot FROM items WHERE item_id = #{itemId}) AS sub )
